_doc: Codex-painted textures for the House Kit atlas (owner 2026-11-26: 'Codex painted in a world of warcraft type of style. Big wood regions, borders, panels'). Each row is ONE square picture painted by Codex (tools/codex-textures.mjs writes ref/<id>/painted.png); tools/build-atlas.py makes each one tile seamlessly, shrinks it into its atlas slot and writes textures/atlas.webp + data/atlas.json. `tile` = how the picture is used: 'wrap' repeats both ways, 'band' repeats along its width only (its height spans a beam or plank face, painted edges and all), 'cells' is a grid of separate pictures (sign emblems). `slot` = [col, row] in the 4x4 atlas, or [col, row, sub] for one quarter of a slot (sub 0..3 = top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right). `metres` = how many metres one repeat covers in the world (read by js/paint.js through data/atlas.json).
style: hand-painted stylised fantasy MMO texture in the style of the classic 2004 fantasy MMO towns: chunky, readable shapes, bold painted highlights on top edges and dark painted shadows in the cracks, warm saturated but not neon colours, soft brush strokes, NO photo detail, NO noise grain, NO realism, big simple forms readable from far away

plaster.what: a whitewashed lime PLASTER wall, warm cream-white, painted with broad soft brush strokes, a few gentle darker patches and a couple of small cracks, very subtle, mostly flat and light (it will be tinted, so keep it LIGHT: average brightness about 85%)

timber.what: ONE thick horizontal wooden BEAM seen from the front, filling the whole square: chunky painted oak, warm mid brown, long bold grain strokes running left to right, a dark painted border along the top and bottom edges with a bright highlight line just inside the top edge, two or three dark knots

planks.what: a wall of WIDE WOODEN PLANKS running left to right, 5 planks stacked top to bottom, each plank a slightly different warm brown, dark painted gaps between planks, bold painted grain, a few round iron nail heads at the plank ends

stone.what: a wall of BIG CUT STONE BLOCKS in neat staggered courses (4 courses top to bottom, blocks about twice as wide as tall), warm grey-beige stone, each block with a bright painted top-left bevel and dark painted mortar lines, slight colour variation block to block

fieldstone.what: a FIELDSTONE rubble wall of big rounded irregular stones of mixed sizes packed in dark mortar, grey with some brown and blue-grey stones, each stone with a bold painted highlight on top and a dark shadow underneath

shingles.what: a roof of WOODEN SHINGLES in staggered horizontal rows (6 rows top to bottom), each shingle a rectangle with a slightly rounded bottom edge, warm mid brown with some lighter and darker shingles, a dark painted shadow under each row

slate.what: a roof of SLATE TILES in staggered horizontal rows (6 rows top to bottom), cool blue-grey slates with pointed or squared bottom edges, light painted highlights on the slate tops and dark shadows under each row

clay.what: a roof of curved terracotta CLAY TILES in horizontal rows (6 rows top to bottom), warm orange-red tiles, each tile with a rounded bottom edge and a bright painted highlight, deep red-brown shadows between them

thatch.what: a THATCHED ROOF of straw bundles: thick layered golden straw in bold strokes running mostly top to bottom, in overlapping horizontal layers (4 layers), warm gold-ochre with darker brown shadows between the layers

cobbles.what: COBBLESTONE paving seen from above: rounded grey and brown cobbles of similar size packed together, dark gaps between them, each cobble with a soft bright painted highlight

door.what: heavy DARK WOOD DOOR PLANKS running top to bottom (4 vertical planks across the square), deep reddish brown, bold painted grain, one dark iron strap running across the middle with round rivets

window.what: LEADED GLASS window panes: a diamond lattice of dark lead lines (3 diamonds across), each diamond pane of glass painted a soft blue-green with a pale reflected highlight in its upper half

ivy.what: a dense mat of IVY LEAVES covering everything: overlapping painted ivy leaves in rich greens, light yellow-green highlights on leaf tops, darker green shadows between, no background showing

flowers.what: a dense BED OF SMALL FLOWERS: clusters of red, pink, yellow, white and violet painted blossoms over small green leaves, filling the whole square, no background showing

signs.what: a sheet of 8 HANGING SHOP SIGN emblems in a 4 x 2 grid of equal squares (each square 384 x 512 pixels): each square is completely filled by a wooden sign board (painted wood, a thick darker wooden border round the edge) with ONE big bold painted emblem in the middle. In order left to right, top row then bottom row: 1 an iron ANVIL (smith), 2 a round glass POTION BOTTLE with red liquid (alchemist), 3 a golden BREAD LOAF (baker), 4 a BED with a red blanket (inn), 5 a wooden hunting BOW with an arrow (bowyer), 6 a steel SWORD point down (armourer), 7 a brown leather BOOT (cobbler), 8 a foaming wooden ALE MUG (tavern). The boards touch the square edges, no black background, no gaps.

iron.what: dark wrought IRON surface: painted blackened iron plate with a few hammer marks, cool dark grey with bold lighter grey highlights along edges and a little rust brown in places

paintwood.what: (not painted by Codex: made from the planks painting, greyed and lightened so a shutter or window box takes its own paint colour)

cloth.what: plain woven CANVAS CLOTH, very light warm cream (it will be tinted), soft painted folds running top to bottom, faint weave, mostly flat and LIGHT
